snippet.title: Last Words Release Trailer (FNAF Fangame)
snippet.description:
Welcome to Last Words, a game created to both celebrate and say farewell to many ideas I must now leave behind. I hope you enjoy this game as much as I did making it, as there's so much to do and so much to see!
